title: Claude Price Action
author: ReasonableLeg9821
selftext: Has anyone been able to properly communicate signals for any price action type trades to Claude for auto entry/ exits?  I manually follow the Al Brooks methodology and have started trying to get an automated trading system which would pick up on some of the "easier" signals,  but am too dumb to properly communicate what I'm looking for it to identify as signals for entries. Anyone have any success with anything along these lines?

comments.author: 206throw
comments.body: I have tried using the API, and dialed all the settings down to get fast response and it did not work for me.  I scalp and typically have 7 to 10 seconds to enter. Also in my experience Anthropic models really dont want to loose money.

comments.author: Careless-Diamond-277
comments.body: Use Chat gpt to get around issues to understand Claude better
